text:
zoe: Post-design review quick notes for Compliance > Retention panel. Found a mix of copy/contrast/focus-order issues. Dropping everything here so eng/product can triage.
max: Uploaded a new artboard with alternate KMS labels: "BYOK" (compact), "Customer KMS" (short), and "Customer-managed key (KMS)" (verbose). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/retention-ux-refresh
anika: Overall preference for clarity: use "Customer-managed key (KMS)" in the details view, but show "Customer KMS" in table rows to avoid wrapping. Don't use unexplained acronyms in the main table.
carlos: Accessibility: the lock icon + pale-blue badge fails contrast on light themes (contrast ~3.0:1). Propose switching icon color to #0F172A or adding a 1px alpha border. Also ensure badge has role="status" and an aria-label like: "Key ownership: Customer-managed, region eu-central-1".
emily: Security/copy: avoid UI phrasing that might imply Redwood has access to key material. Suggested short microcopy for tooltip: "Customer-managed KMS. UI shows key metadata only; key material is managed by customer KMS." Legal wants to review the last clause before it's committed.
azika: (typo) -> anika: UX detail: region control currently reads as "Auto (AMS)" which users misinterpreted. Suggest: "Region: Amsterdam (auto selected)" or compact "AMS (auto)". Make the selection clickable to open region details.
max: On the ARNs: don't render full ARNs in list. Redaction pattern proposal: `arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/xxxx-xxxx-XXXX` -> show `arn:...:key/••••-XXXX` and in tooltip reveal the last 8 chars only. Audit asked for last-8 in exports.
zoe: Export schema change request from compliance: include `timestamp_utc_iso` and `timestamp_local` columns; add `kms_key_redacted` and `kms_key_full_hash` (the latter only in secure exports). Also include `export_generated_at_iso` metadata row.
emily: Wording nuance: replace all UI text instances of "key material" with "key metadata" except where legal explicitly needs the term. Also avoid verbs like "store" or "retain" without legal sign-off.
carlos: Focus order a11y: tab sequence currently: retention dropdown -> details toggle -> region selector. Visual order is region -> retention -> details. We should reorder DOM so tabbing feels linear. Also ensure dropdown helper text uses aria-describedby that remains in DOM even when collapsed.
anika: Timestamps in audit list: product wanted relative times but compliance insisted on absolute times with timezone. Compromise: show compact absolute time (e.g., "2026-11-01 09:12 (UTC)") as primary and relative on hover, or vice versa. Which should be default?
max: For readability on dense tables, recommend inline pattern: "2026-11-01 09:12 (UTC) — 3h ago" with the ISO full string in tooltip `2026-11-01T09:12:03+00:00`. That keeps rows single-line.
\emoji: (not a user)
emily: Also flag: audit copy currently uses "key material" in an event description sample: "Key material rotated". Suggest replacing with "KMS key rotated (metadata only)". Audit-bot should pick up these strings during scan.
audit-bot: policy-scan: found potential risky phrase "we manage your keys" in artboard:desktop-v2.png line 14. Severity: high. Recommended replacement: "Redwood does not have access to key material". Requires legal review.
zoe: Action items: 1) Max to add compact badge + tooltip copy variants and update figma notes (due tomorrow) 2) Carlos to open contrast/accessibility PR with color tokens and focus-order fixes (PR by EOD) 3) Anika to draft final region labeling patterns and compact/expanded specs (in figma) 4) Emily to coordinate legal wording and confirm export header list with compliance. I'll block staging until the critical copy and export headers are signed off.
max: I'll also include a CSV preview in the figma notes with sample values so compliance can see the redaction pattern.
carlos: Quick dev note: if we inline UTC+relative, ensure sorting still uses native timestamp column, not rendered text. Use data-order attribute for tables.
zoe: Thanks team 44d — we can do a 10m sync if anyone wants to talk through the export format. Otherwise leave comments in figma and this thread.
